focus_areas: Structural integrity of the telescope mount and base connection to ground.
Edge sharpness of the parabolic dish against the sky.
Consistency of scale between the foreground, mid-ground, and background elements.
Texture realism of the foreground vegetation.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the main telescope. AI generators often struggle with complex mechanical feet touching uneven ground. Check if the 'legs' of the mount dissolve into the grass. Also, verify if the second and third telescopes in the distance maintain correct geometric proportions relative to the main one, or if they appear as distorted 'blobs'.
